summary.text: I'm a Computer Science undergraduate at Anurag University (Class of 2028) with a passion for full-stack web development and problem-solving. I work across the MERN stack — MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js — and have hands-on experience in C++, Python, and Java.Beyond code, I coordinate events for Malai Club and create technical content for the IEEE Computer Society AU CEG Student Branch, which has sharpened my communication and leadership skills alongside my engineering ones.I'm actively looking for internship opportunities in software development and web engineering where I can contribute to real-world products and grow fast.📌 Skills: React.js · Node.js · MongoDB · Express.js · REST APIs · C++ · Python · JavaScript · HTML/CSS📌 Open to: SDE Internships · Full Stack Roles · Remote & On-site
